FI_MothershipLost_01: Mothership damage is massive, life support systems unsustainable. All personnel to the escape pods.
FI_MothershipLost_05: Catastrophic damage to Mothership. All hands to the escape pods.
FI_MothershipLost_06: All systems critically compromised. Abandon the Mothership.
FI_MothershipLost_07: Loss of structural integrity. Life support failing. Evacuate the Mothership at once.
FI_MothershipLost_08: Complete systems failure. Mothership crew must abandon ship.
FI_UnlockAssaultFrigate: With the technology transferred from the Shipyard, we can build a new ship: Assault Frigates. These heavy weapon craft are ideal for penetrating the Radaa defenses guarding the shield emitters.
FI_UnlockBalisticDestroyer: The Weapons Architects had ship plans we have put into use: we can now build Ballistic Destroyers, whose advanced Missile Barrage will be needed against the heavy Radaa fleet present in this sector.
FI_UnlockBarricadeFrigate: With the technology the Bentusi provided, our construction bays can now build Barricade Frigates. When activated, these can provide shields for nearby ships. They can also be used to protect the Bentusi.
FI_UnlockDestroyer: Our ship construction capabilities have been upgraded to build a new ship: Destroyers. These capital class ships have weapon systems most effective against squadrons of strike craft.
FI_UnlockEngineerCraft: Resources claimed from Gybbas allow us to build a new ship: the Engineer Craft, which has the ability to repair ships in their Strike Group. They are also key to capturing the Radaa Destroyer in this sector.
FI_UnlockHeavyCorvette: Our ongoing repairs to the Mothership has added ship build capabilities: we can now build Heavy Corvettes. Their armor is ideal against heavy ballistics from the gun platforms we have detected in this sector.
FI_UnlockHeavyCruiser: From the wreckage of the Radaa shipyards we recovered technology to build a new ship: Heavy Cruisers have advanced weapon systems optimal for destroying the Shatter Station wings, once their shields are disabled.
FI_UnlockIonFrigate: The Bentusi also provided us the key components necessary to build a new ship class: Ion Frigates, which are ideal for long range attacks and cutting into the hulls of larger ships.
FI_UnlockMultiGunCorvette: Our engineering team has added capability to our construction bays: Multi-Gun Corvettes. These are ideal for counter-attack against the Radaa's fast-moving threats to the shipyard.
M01_010_010_A_HA: After a long exile, we Hiigarans at last welcomed peace in our home.
M01_010_020_A_HA: Our great Mothership, with Karan S'jet fused as its Commander, Navigator and living core, allowed our people to carve a fiery path from exile to home and freedom. Now the Mothership rests in orbit around Hiigara, a tribute to those times and the great generation that sacrificed everything to find and claim our Homeworld.
M01_010_030_A_HA: Though the Taiidani empire had fallen, the new Hiigarans were caught off guard by the short but deadly BeastWar. The Daiamid, the ruling council of the Hiigaran people, were painfully aware that they were alone in the Galaxy. So when the Radaa - interstellar traders with their own mysterious technology - approached with offers of an alliance and exchange, the Daiamid was very receptive.
M01_010_040_A_HA: The Radaa believed that the longer we were at peace, the more vulnerable we became. Their leader, Commander Amma, warned that former Taiidani bandit kingdoms were re-arming and a new Empire was a real possibility.  In exchange for permission to build and mine in the Hiigaran star system, Commander Amma offered to shepherd the Hiigaran Fleet through a new era of modernization and growth.
M01_010_050_A_HA: So we began to forge a new military force with our new allies.  We also pulled the original Mothership out of retirement and built her back up.  The Radaa were very interested in the Ship that had defeated the Taiidani Empire.
M01_010_060_A_HA: Karan S'jet retired years ago, but she was still the only being that had learned to control the Mothership by direct link to its Progenitor core. She agreed to return to the Mothership project but this time only as an instructor. She had earned her peace.
M01_010_070_A_HA: The role of Fleet Command fell to Tyrra Soban. A peerless military veteran, she had fought countless battles in the splintering remains of the Taiidani empire, and had broken up dozens of Raider groups.
M01_010_080_A_HA: To take command of the Mothership and the Fleet, she underwent the same process that Karan S'jet had decades before. She was a trained warrior and that would make it clear to anyone that the Mothership was now a warship, pure and direct.Tyrra Soban was only the second of our people to become unbound.
M01_020_005_KS: I knew you could do it.
M01_020_010_FI: We are early for our rendezvous with the Radaa.
M01_020_020_TS: Let's not put the time to waste.  Scanning for Resources in our vicinity.
M01_020_030_FI: Acknowledged.  Command, this sector is rife with asteroids and rich dust clouds.
M01_020_035_FI: One of your Strike Groups contains Resource Collectors which can be used for harvesting. Initiate at will.
M01_020_050_KS: Former Commander.  Your ship, your orders, Commander Tyrra Soban.
M01_025_010_FI: Necessary Resources secured.  Continuing to gather Resources is important for Mothership systems health, and keeps our construction bays capable of building more ships.
M01_025_020_FI: We now have the Resources to build a Scout unit so we can pinpoint the location of the Radaa.
M01_030_010_GR: Greetings, Hiigaran Command, this is Radaa Admiral Giitan. Our Commander Amma relays her wishes for our long and fruitful partnership with the Hiigaran people.
M01_030_015_GR: And now that pleasantries are out of the way, let us begin. I live for a good battle.
M01_030_030_FI: Radaa craft signatures detected in this sector.
M01_030_040_GR: I thought it best for our skirmish to involve live fire.  I've found it's the only way to truly learn.  Are we agreed?  Good.
M01_030_050_FI: To gain precise coordinates on the Radaa craft, have your Scout perform reconnaissance with a Sensor Sweep.
M01_035_010_FI: The first Radaa skirmish group has been detected.
M01_035_020_KS: This is it, Fleet Command.  Take them on with one of your combat Strike Groups.
M01_040_020_KS: Do you see their position in the Sensors Manager?
M01_050_020_KS: Intelligence reports say the Radaa utilize very high level technology, but I haven't seen anything remarkable yet.
M01_060_010_AR: Hiigaran command, I am Amma, Commander of the Radaa Fleet. I am declaring Taiidani agreement TR-3 in effect.
M01_060_030_AR: In return for a considerable investment from us, the Taiidani Emperor agreed to share all technology related to a Hyperspace Core.
M01_060_050_AR: When the Taiidan Empire fell, you inherited the planet Hiigara and all legal agreements pertaining to it.
M01_060_055_AR: You are bound by that agreement to relinquish your Hyperspace Core or face default. Thank you for your cooperation.
M01_060_060_FI: Radaa Frigates have jumped in near the Mothership.
M01_060_070_KS: Scanning Radaa Frigates...They are a Beta class threat, the could do us great harm. They are not joking.
M01_060_080_AR: Your governing body has not complied in the given time period and is in default.
M01_060_085_AR: Though we anticipated this result we wish to assure you we are only taking what is legally ours.
M01_060_085_GR: Time to cooperate and stand down.
M01_060_090_TS: I've got your cooperation right here.  Fleet to battle positions!
M01_070_010_FI: Radaa Frigates neutralized but the Mothership has sustained significant damage.  Additional Radaa units incoming.
M01_070_020_KS: Tyrra, there's too many. I know the Mothership won't take much more of this. You have to jump us out of here.
M01_070_030_TS: That is my decision Karan S'jet... but you are not wrong. We need an isolated location to regroup. Jumping the Mothership and fleet now.
M01_080_010_GR: The Skirmish is won.  Our victory, your loss.  You will need to do better.
M01_090_010_FI: Catastrophic losses reported.  Hiigaran fleet has been eliminated.
M01_100_010_FI: Mothership has sustained massive damages. I repeat: Mothership incapacitated, Radaa forces will capture it.
M01_110_010_FI: The Radaa Missile Frigates are capable of breaching the hull of the Mothership.
M01_120_010_FI: Damage to the Mothership from the hull breach is substantial, our situation is urgent.
M01_130_020_KS: They'll take the Mothership if we can't end this fast.
M01_Objective_00: Harvest RU from asteroids to a total of 200.
M01_Objective_00a: Use your RU to Build a Scout.
M01_Objective_00b: Locate the Radaa patrol using Scout Sensor Sweep Ability.
M01_Objective_02: Defend the Mothership from the Radaa.
M03_010_008_A_TS: Radaa forces repelled. Any word from the Galactic Council?
M03_010_010_A_KS: They report that the Radaa claims may be legally valid, but any attempts to call for a cease fire are being blocked by the Radaa and the council members they have made deals with.  The Bentusi are abstaining!
M03_010_020_A_TS: Fine,  Hiigara stands alone...again.  And we are the tip of the spear.
M03_010_030_A_KS: Intelligence, how much damage did the Mothership sustain?
M03_010_035_A_FI: Minimal damage to core systems. Older, non-critical systems breaking down under stress. Repairs nearly complete.
M03_010_040_A_TS: Good! I won't wait for the Radaa's next move that will just get us stuck in a defensive war I can't win. Time for the one thing the Radaa won't expect from us: we are going to attack.
M03_010_050_A_KS: The size of our fleet pales in comparison to theirs. You're still learning to control the Mothership.
M03_010_060_A_TS: I may be new to the ship, but I'm not new to leading a fleet. What is the closest Radaa outpost?
M03_010_070_A_FI: The Radaa have built a ship yard in high orbit above Gybbas on the outer edge of our system.
M03_010_090_A_KS: It's a bold move, I admit.
M03_010_100_A_TS: I would never risk our people if it weren't the right move.
M03_010_110_A_FI: Repairs complete. Transferring coordinates for the Orbital Shipyard.
M03_020_010_TS: Hyperspace Jump successful, right outside enemy sensor range. Fleet, identify targets.
M03_020_020_FI: The Radaa strip asteroids in this sector, resulting in numerous resource fields. Radaa presence in each varies.
M03_020_030_KS: The key will be to take out one of the Radaa's Mobile Refineries without engaging their whole fleet.  It will not be easy.
M03_020_040_TS: Then I will carefully choose the one with the best tactical potential. Or maybe I will choose two.
M03_030_010_FI: Confirmed, Radaa Refinery eliminated.  The field is ours.
M03_030_020_KS: The Radaa haven't committed their full fleet yet.
M03_030_030_TS: I am keeping our movements variable.  If the Radaa guess wrong about our next objective, I will make them pay for it.  And they know it.
M03_030_040_KS: You are a dangerous opponent, Tyrra.
M03_030_050_TS: High praise from the woman who brought down the Taiidani Empire.
M03_030_060_KS: I had a lot of help.
M03_030_070_TS: And I have you. But I can feel our opponent getting tired of this dance. Whichever resource field I pick next, we will be facing many more Radaa forces.
M03_040_010_FI: Radaa Refinery neutralized.  Detecting numerous Radaa forces on intercept course.
M03_040_020_TS: I knew it.  All ships, pull back to the Mothership, now!
M03_060_010_FI: Our fleet is in range of the Mothership.
M03_060_020_TS: Hyperspace Jump on my command. We have achieved our goal here.  The Radaa know we Hiigarans are ready to fight.
M03_070_010_FI: Retreat! Critical loss of ships. Surviving ships retreat immediately.
M03_Description: Lead a daring raid on a Radaa mining operation around Gybbas.
M03_Objective_02: Destroy a second Radaa Mobile Refinery.
M03_Objective_03: Return your strike groups to the Mothership.
M03_Objective_DestroyA: Destroy the Radaa Refinery near RU Field A.
M03_Objective_DestroyB: Destroy the Radaa Refinery near RU Field B.
M03_Objective_DestroyC: Destroy the Radaa Refinery near RU Field C.
M03_Objective_DestroyD: Destroy the Radaa Refinery near RU Field D.
M04_010_010_A_FI: Commander, we are picking up a distress beacon.
M04_010_020_A_TS: Receiving... it's not one of ours.
M04_010_030_A_FI: Confirmed, it is from a Radaa Destroyer. It's signaling failing drives and life support...but weapon systems still functional.
M04_010_040_A_TS: Convenient. It could be a trap.
M04_010_050_A_KS: When I fought the Taiidani, captured ships were critical for understanding what we were up against.
M04_010_060_A_TS: So trap or not, it's a chance worth taking.
M04_010_080_A_TS: Spoken like a true S'jet. Fleet Intelligence, monitor the area for Radaa ships. We are going in.
M04_020_010_KS: These ships! They must have been a Hiigaran patrol.
M04_020_030_FI: All disabled. No signs of life.
M04_020_040_KS: Just floating... lost souls without a mark on any ship. A Radaan Destroyer couldn't have just neutralized them like this.
M04_020_050_TS: And yet here they are... Initiate search for what could have caused this.
M04_020_060_FI: High concentrations of asteroid debris are interfering with scans. We are detecting multiple Radaa strike craft incoming.
M04_020_070_TS: They will never make this easy.
M04_030_010_FI: Radaa Destroyer located. Enemy forces are en route to intercept.
M04_030_020_TS: Strike Groups, intercept the Radaa before they reach their target.
M04_030_030_KS: All this debris makes for a dangerous place to fight.
M04_030_040_TS: All ships, keep a close eye on sensors.
M04_040_020_KS: Too exposed out here. More Radaa will come before we can extract any intel.
M04_040_030_TS: So we haul the Destroyer back to the Mothership.
M04_040_040_FI: Transporting the Destroyer will require multiple Engineer Craft.
M04_050_010_FI: All Engineer Craft are in place. Destroyer on course.
M04_050_020_KS: The Radaa will attempt to eradicate that Destroyer before letting us capture it.
M04_060_010_FI: New signature detected.  Radaa Strike Craft emerging from Hyperspace Gate.
M04_060_020_TS: They really don't want us to get ahold of that Destroyer.
M04_060_030_KS: If we get the Destroyer to the Mothership, we can jump away with it. Or we can destroy the Hyperspace Gate to cripple the Radaa. Fleet Command, it's your call.
M04_070_010_FI: Hyperspace Gate neutralized.  Radaa forces in retreat.
M04_070_020_TS: And now, to the victor goes the prize.
M04_070_030_FI: We have a lock on the Destroyer.  Hyperspace jump ready on your command.
M04_080_010_FI: The Destroyer is in range of the Mothership with Radaa forces in retreat. We are clear to jump on your command.
M04_100_010_FI: Too many ships destroyed, we are out of options. Retreat, retreat.
M04_100_020_FI: The Destroyer has taken critical damage, our objective is lost.
M04_Objective_02: Destroy all hostiles around the Radaa Destroyer.
M04_Objective_03: Dock 3 Engineer Craft to the Radaa Destroyer.
M04_Objective_04: Defend the Radaa Destroyer while it is en route to the Mothership.
M05_010_010_A_TS: Chief Engineer Hauk, what is your analysis of the data we sent you on our captured Radaa Destroyer?
M05_010_020_A_HA: It's been a challenge, Commander.  We saw very little consistency to their systems, but then we realized we were looking at a fusion of Taiidani, Bentus and even our own technology.  There are also some components we've never seen before.
M05_010_030_A_KS: Did Radaa tech render all those ships inoperable?
M05_010_040_A_HA: Too early to say. My engineering team should have an educated guess very soon.
M05_010_050_A_TS: I can't afford guesses, Hauk.  I need an edge.  Something we can use right away.
M05_010_060_A_HA: Science is not something you can shoot, Commander.   I will have some--
M05_010_070_A_FI: Another distress call, Fleet Command.  This time it's one of ours.  Hiigaran Orbital Shipyard Dalkaar is under siege.
M05_010_075_A_KS: There are thousands of civilians on that station. Families.
M05_010_080_A_TS: Burning Hells! And if they take that Shipyard, Hiigara herself is wide open. No one is putting Hiigarans in chains again. Fleet, full alert and prepare for jump!
M05_020_010_FI: Hyperspace jump complete, the Shipyard is in range, and vulnerable.
M05_020_020_HA: Fleet Command - our construction systems are down, defenses are badly reduced.  We won't survive another attack wave.
M05_020_030_FI: Radaa Strike Craft about to enter firing range.
M05_020_040_TS: We are going to make them regret threatening our people.
M05_030_010_HA: Fleet Command, you have a whole station cheering you on.  If you continue to provide defense, my team can focus on our analysis.
M05_030_020_TS: We each have our jobs to do, Chief Engineer.
M05_030_030_FI: Commander, there is an incoming Radaa transmission. It is broadcasting to Hiigara and all craft in orbit.
M05_030_040_GR: Per our agreement, surrender the Mothership and its Hyperspace Core, or we will destroy the balance of your assets.
M05_030_050_TS: Our people are expendable to them, just negotiating points. And I'm not negotiating.
M05_040_020_TS: What use will hesitation be If they take the shipyard. Our people...  My only son is on board.
M05_040_030_KS: Chief Engineer Hauk?  But isn't he...
M05_040_040_TS: As a boy he found the ways of your people more familiar than the traditions of the Kiith he was born into. Do you have people close to you in the fleet?
M05_040_050_KS: S'jets may not be a warrior kiith but we go where we are needed.
M05_040_060_FI: Contact. Numerous Radaa Strike Craft detected.
M05_050_010_FI: Sensors are picking up a massive influx of Radaa ships.
M05_050_020_KS: They are sending everything they have at us.
M05_050_030_TS: They will regret sending so many.
M05_070_010_FI: No further Radaa signatures. Shipyard superstructure still intact, damages minimal.
M05_070_020_KS: You did it. The shipyard is safe. Your son is...
M05_070_030_TS: ...not safe until all the Radaa are gone from this system. None of us are.
M05_100_010_FI: Abort, abort. Unable to defend the Shipyard.
M05_110_010_FI: The shipyard is damaged beyond repair. Surviving crew are heading for the escape pods.
M05_Description: Defend an orbital Shipyard from the Radaa.
M06_010_010_A_TS: Radaa expelled. Shipyard still in orbit, and Officer Hauk will board shortly with his engineering team and a report.
M06_010_020_A_KS: Tyrra, you are mastering the Mothership like you were born to it. Far faster than I did.
M06_010_030_A_TS: I have something you didn't: a good advisor.
M06_010_040_A_KS: You may not need me much longer.
M06_010_050_A_TS: I wouldn't say that, but since there is no safe place to disembark the Hero of the Homeworld War, we are in this together for the duration. It's time to attack their command structure. What do we know of their base of operations?
M06_010_100_A_FI: Their home base is mobile – they call it Radaa Tower – they often station it within one system to do business, then move on.
M06_010_110_A_KS: And now they're doing business with us.
M06_010_120_A_TS: The attack on the Orbital Shipyard was a misdirect. To keep us occupied while they established their main base.  Intel, find that Tower!
M06_010_130_A_FI: Scanning...picking up a massive energy signature in Hiigara shadow. Indications are that it is Radaa Tower. Transferring coordinates.
M06_010_140_A_TS: That's it. Time to show that Hiigarans are not easy prey. Let's finish this.
M06_020_010_FI: Radaa forces are swarming around the tower.
M06_020_020_TS: They are a distraction. Our target is the tower.
M06_020_023_AR: Hiigaran Mothership, Fleet Command.  We Radaa have been waiting patiently for you to turn over our property.
M06_020_025_TS: Ignore her  - we're not hear to talk.  Hauk, is that distortion around it a shield?
M06_020_030_HA: It appears so.  They would need maybe... four Shield Emitters to generate one that large.
M06_020_040_KS: I worked on that technology - something else they stole from us.  We won't get anywhere without taking down those shield emitters.
M06_020_050_TS: Understood. Engineer Craft, prepare to deploy and find those Shield Emitters!
M06_030_010_FI: Shield Emitter located. Engineer Craft must dock to disable it.
M06_040_010_FI: Engineer Craft is disabling the Shield Emitter, but it is vulnerable to attack.
M06_050_010_FI: Shield Emitter disabled. Remaining Shield Emitters still active.
M06_060_020_AR: This is your last opportunity to abide by your planet's standing agreement.  Your present actions make me fear that you are not listening.  But we can escalate our efforts to force you to surrender our assets.  The choice is yours.
M06_060_030_TS: Shut off the com channel and keep searching for those Shield Emitters.
M06_070_010_FI: Third Shield Emitter now disabled. Scan for the fourth.
M06_075_010_FI: The last Shield Emitter has been disabled.
M06_075_030_TS: But now the Radaa Tower is wide open.  All ships, we have a new target.
M06_080_010_FI: Unknown Radaa station has jumped in.
M06_080_043_KS: I don't like this. Spin up our core!
M06_080_045_TS: We've come this far, we can fight this. But prepping for jump in case your fear is warranted.
M06_080_050_FI: Station appears to be powering up.
M06_080_060_KS: They're targeting us!  We must hyperspace jump now!
M06_080_070_TS: Analyzing weak points of Radaa Station. Targeting weapon...
M06_080_090_TS: Unclear... sensors... can't see... can't hear... attempting... attempting to...
M06_080_100_FI: Fleet incapacitated. Trying to reestablish contact.
M06_080_120_TS: Shaping coordinates for...  for jump to...  isolation point. They won't get this ship. Prepare... prepare...for...hy-
M06_100_010_FI: Resources depleted. Critical loss of Hiigaran ships. Full retreat unavoidable.
M06_Objective_02: Dock an Engineer Craft to the shield emitter.
M07_010_010_A_TS: Hyperspace jump complete. Here we can assess our damage and get our systems back online without endangering Hiigara.
M07_010_020_A_KS: They were after the Mothership and the Progenitor Core all along.
M07_010_030_A_TS: Sands and sinners!  This is very bad.
M07_010_050_A_TS: The Daiamid has grown complacent.  Peace has made all the Kiith-Sa's too trusting. They didn't see the Radaa for what they are.
M07_010_060_A_KS: From what I have read they are deal makers – no home planet and they often use ships they acquired from other peoples.  Compared to the Taiidan, they seemed harmless.  But recrimination won't change where we are now.
M07_010_070_A_TS: Intel!  I need an enemy to strike.  What do we know about their leadership?
M07_010_080_A_FI: The Radaa Commander is Amma – she inherited the job from her father and she is known as a shrewd negotiator.
M07_010_090_A_FI: Her son Giitan acts as her second in command, known for his ruthlessness.
M07_010_100_A_KS: Before we lost contact with Hiigara, we were informed the Daiamid sent an emergency appeal to the Galactic Council to seek assistance. No word on how long it will take.  We need to buy the Homeworld time.
M07_010_110_A_TS: The Hiigaran fleet is in no shape for battle.  Some of our fleet is out of commission, supposedly being "upgraded" by the Radaa, while others are scattered on maneuvers. It’s up to us.
M07_010_120_A_KS: Tyrra, I know the rage you are feeling.  I watched Kharak burn.  But emotion drained me when I first fought as the Mothership. Focus on staying calm.
M07_010_130_A_TS: No offense, Karan, but rarely does a Soban require war wisdom from a S'jet.
M07_010_140_A_FI: Radaan fighters on deep sensors.  We have incoming!
M07_010_150_A_TS: Very well, let's see what this Mothership can do.
M07_020_020_FI: Radaa forces are approaching.  They must have honed in on the core signature.
M07_020_030_KS: Resource reserves were wiped out when our supply bays were hit.  We will have to gather more.
M07_020_050_KS: Construction facilities still offline. We will have to fight with the fleet we have. We have deployed all reserve ships.
M07_020_080_TS: Sensors are down. I'm nearly blind!
M07_020_090_FI: To repair the Sensors Manager, we will need to collect more resources.
M07_030_010_TS: Sensors back online. Comms back at full.
M07_030_020_FI: We are receiving a transmission from Admiral Giitan of the Radaa.
M07_030_030_GR: Hiigaran Mothership, you have attempted to flee with our property.  Do not underestimate our perseverance in claiming our assets.
M07_030_040_TS: This is a farce.  No warrior fights on technicalities and lies.
M07_030_050_KS: Lies or not, we must secure more resources to get the Mothership's construction bays back online.
M07_040_010_TS: Ship build systems online. Fleet prepare to engage.
M07_040_013_KS: Commander, should we be fighting right where the Radaa want us?
M07_040_015_TS: An excellent point, Karan.  I concur.  Intel, how long will I need to spin up the Hyperspace Core?
M07_040_020_FI: Engineering reports they are still dealing with damaged conduits.
M07_040_030_TS: First I am told we have to go and now I am told I can't leave!
M07_040_040_TS: Intel, make engineering aware that their time is paid for in lives.  All ships, hold the Radaa off until we are cleared to jump.
M07_050_010_FI: Hyperspace systems are primed and ready.
M07_050_020_TS: Inputting coordinates to a safe harbor. Jumping... now.
M07_100_010_FI: Fleet eliminated. Mothership repair incomplete. Escape pods activated.
M07_Description: Defend the Mothership while it is repaired.
M07_Objective_01a: Harvest 700 RU to bring Sensors back online.
M07_Objective_01b: Time until jump drive is recharged:
M07_Objective_02: Defend the Mothership during structural repairs.
M07_Objective_02a: Harvest 2000 total RU to restore construction sytems.
M07_Objective_03: Defend the Mothership while jump drive spins up.
M08_010_010_A_KS: Weapons Architects secured. Mothership operational. Engineering, are we ready to face Shatter Station?
M08_010_030_A_HA: That makes no sense!  Explain again, slime-merchant, or so help me...
M08_010_050_A_HA: Sorry...Command, we're running simulations, but our guest is not being as helpful as I had hoped. We need more time. I won't send you in without knowing I can protect you. I won't lose you too.
M08_010_060_A_KS: I'm sorry. It should have been me.
M08_010_070_A_FI: Reports show that the Radaa have returned to the Orbital Shipyards around Gybbas. They are building up a massive fleet.
M08_010_080_A_KS: If we don't break up that fleet it won't matter if we stop Shatter Station.
M08_010_090_A_FI: Our intelligence on the sector is excellent, and we now have the firepower to destroy that Shipyard if we can get close enough.
M08_010_100_A_KS: Then that is the solution. Chief Engineer Hauk, you will get your time. We will pick up where you left off, Tyrra.
M08_020_010_KS: Hyperspace Jump successful. Gybbas orbit achieved.
M08_020_020_FI: Picking up a massive Radaa defense fleet. Our capital ships will need a clear attack path to destroy the Shipyard.
M08_020_030_KS: The Radaa were clearly preparing for another attack from Tyrra. We will not disappoint.
M08_030_010_FI: Radaa Shipyard has been destroyed.  Fleet objectives met.
M08_030_020_KS: Tyrra would not stop here.  Do we have sufficient resources to take the second Shipyard?
M08_030_030_FI: Onboard systems report peak functionality.  But the other Radaa Shipyards are deploying heavy reinforcements.
M08_030_040_KS: I have the solution for this equation. All ships, bring down that second shipyard.
M08_040_010_FI: Second Shipyard neutralized.  Destroying the last Shipyard would negate their ability to reinforce their fleets in the Hiigara system.
M08_040_020_KS: Fleet, status report.  Can we get this job done?
M08_040_030_FI: All ships and all systems report Green.  The word from fleet is "Aye!".
M08_040_040_KS: Then let's not give them anymore time to build their fleet.  All gunners, set the third Radaa Shipyard as priority alpha.
M08_050_010_FI: All Radaa Shipyards destroyed. Remaining Radaa forces are in disarray.
M08_050_020_KS: Initiate a coms link through to our entire Fleet.
M08_050_040_KS: This is Commander Karan S'jet on all coms. We have been pushed to the brink, but know this - Tyrra Soban never doubted our ability.
M08_050_050_KS: Your victory today proves she was right. We will reclaim Hiigara. Command out.
M08_060_010_FI: Pull back! Materials and ships overextended. Retreat unavoidable.
M08_Description: Stage an all out assault on The Radaa Shipyards around Gybbas.
M09_003_010_A_FI: We have successfully jumped to the Tenhauser System. Damage reports coming in.  What are your orders, Commander?
M09_003_030_A_FI: Command is unresponsive. Med teams to Command Pod.
M09_003_050_A_FI: Med teams reporting negative life signs.
M09_003_070_A_FI: ...Fleet Command Tyrra Soban... confirmed killed in action. Med teams report complete neural failure. The Radaa weapon overloaded the Commander's link to the mothership.
M09_003_073_A_KS: She should have broken the link!
M09_003_075_A_FI: Commander Tyrra Soban's last command was to initiate emergency hyperspace.
M09_003_080_A_KS: Oh Tyrra... All that the Mothership can do… you were its heart.  And it cost you everything to save us.
M09_003_090_A_FI: Unknown weapon has disabled the majority of the fleet.
M09_003_110_A_FI: Damaged, AI systems maintaining ship basic operation.  Emergency teams are moving the Commander to Medbay Twelve.
M09_003_120_A_KS: How long before the Radaa find us?
M09_003_130_A_FI: Unknown. But it is highly probable that you are correct - they will be coming.
M09_003_140_A_KS: No time. Under the Kharak Emergency Protocols, I am assuming command of the Mothership.
M09_003_145_A_KS: Alert the med teams that I am on my way to the command pod. Tell them to access medical file, Karan-zero-zero-zero.
M09_003_160_A_HA: When Tyrra Soban fell, no one but Karan S'jet could take her place as Fleet Command. This time, she did not hesitate.
M09_005_010_KS: Life support calibrated. I am connected to all operant systems. Navigator embedded, I am... unbound.
M09_005_020_FI: Repair progress at fifty percent. Additional resources needed to restore mothership to full functionality. Sensor systems at partial functionality.
M09_005_030_KS: We used the last of our resources to save the ship.
M09_005_050_KS: I am detecting massive damage to structural integrity and internal systems. Construction facilities down.
M09_005_060_FI: Repair looks impossible without key components we do not have in our reserves.
M09_005_070_KS: Damage control. Cannibalize what you can, invent what you can't. I won't let this be hopeless. Tyrra, your sacrifice will have meaning.
M09_005_080_FI: Sensors detecting powerful anomalous signature. Can't lock it down. Also picking up potential Radaa ships on incoming vectors.
M09_005_090_KS: We have to get sensors back, at least.  We need those resources.
M09_008_010_KS: Sensors back online. This is what I remember.
M09_008_020_FI: We have intercepted communication from Admiral Giitan.
M09_008_030_GR: They can't hide from us, they can't fight us, Shatter Station hit its target. Bring me what's left of the Mothership! Bring me that Progenitor Core.
M09_008_040_KS: Shatter Station. That's what left us broken. We're not ready to fight.
M09_020_005_BN: We remember you, Karan S'jet, Seeker of The Home. You are now again what you will be. Unbound. And we welcome you to your place.
M09_020_010_KS: Thank you. But why are you here, now? At this point in spacetime?
M09_020_020_BN: Hiigarans are worthy of our help. The Radaa are not.
M09_020_040_BN: We shape the galaxy on honorable exchange and the sharings of Knowledge. The Radaa trade flawed systems that prove useless in order to take what they desire. Thieves. Agents of Entropy.
M09_020_050_KS: Have you faced their weapon that can disable a fleet in one blast?  They call it Shatter Station.
M09_020_060_BN: We are aware, and that is why we came Karan S'jet.  First, we have the technology to heal you.  Initiating transfer.
M09_020_070_KS: Bentusi technology received. Construction bays are online and fully functional.
M09_020_080_BN: We can hear the whispers of the technology the Radaa have stolen from us--
M09_030_010_BN: The Radaa have come for you.
M09_030_020_KS: They must have followed our core signature.
M09_030_030_BN: We are not willing to fight the stolen parts of Ourselves. The Radaa have made a wall in our sector by placing multiple hyperspace gates.
M09_030_040_KS: All systems back online, we are prepared to fight. Then we hope you can tell us about their technology.
M09_040_010_FI: Hyperspace gate destroyed. Locate remaining gates.
M09_050_010_FI: Hyperspace gate eliminated. More gates remain.
M09_060_010_FI: Gate destruction confirmed. Scanning for more gates.
M09_080_010_BN: You kept your word, Karan S'jet of Hiigara.  What we understand of the devastating Radaa weapon we can share with you.
M09_080_015_BN: It operates off a rare mineral found in the Outer Reef. You can also use this mineral to protect against it. We can provide specific details.
M09_080_020_KS: Chief Engineer Hauk, prepare to receive data from the Bentusi.
M09_080_030_BN: We do not wish to hear the Radaa again. The Galaxy will not be less for the loss of their Song. Use our knowledge to ensure it is silenced. Farewell.
M09_090_010_FI: Too many ships destroyed, resource stores depleted. Retreat underway.
M09_100_010_FI: Bentusi ship taking substantial damage. We need to defend it.
M09_110_010_FI: Bentusi ship will not be able to withstand attack for much longer.
M09_120_010_FI: Bentusi ship critically damaged, hull integrity lost, repeat the Bentusi are lost.
M09_Description: Rebuild the Mothership and seek the help of an old ally.
M10_010_010_A_KS: Fleet Command online. Assessing all systems.
M10_010_020_A_HA: The Bentusi’s information about the Radaa technology… this is exactly what we need to bring them down, just like they brought down our fleet… and my mother.
M10_010_030_A_KS: Hauk.... Tyrra is the only reason we are still here to continue the fight...she sacrificed everything to save us... To save you.
M10_010_033_A_HA: I know. She was better at tactics than she was as a mother, but she will walk with me always.
M10_010_040_A_HA: The Bentusi data shows a device we could construct to counter the Shatter Station weapon but we will need a substantial amount of a rare conductive silicon.
M10_010_050_A_FI: We have identified a supply in an old mining operation located at an outer reef asteroid field. Coordinates confirmed. There may be hostiles in the vicinity.
M10_010_060_A_KS: Tyrra would not hesitate, and we will not waste this chance. Prepare for Hyperspace jump, on my command. And we will let them know that we are still brave.
M10_020_010_KS: Hyperspace jump successful. Scan for the silicon material.
M10_020_020_HA: I'm seeing multiple asteroid fields. There are several abandoned mining platforms that were placed to extract the silicon.
M10_020_040_FI: Detecting Radaa strike craft around the Platforms and throughout this sector.
M10_020_050_KS: Clearly not exhausted. And if the Radaa want it, we cannot let them have it. Calling up Strike Groups.
M10_020_060_FI: Radaa forces moving to secure the Mining Platforms.
M10_020_070_HA: We need all the resonant silicon we can get our hands on.  Engineer Craft can recover the mineral from the platforms.  But they will need protection.
M10_020_080_KS: So we will eliminate the Radaa and take the platforms, one by one.
M10_030_010_FI: First mining platform secured.  Engineer Craft mineral recovery well under way.
M10_040_010_FI: Next mining platform secured, silicon recovery has commenced.
M10_040_020_FI: There is a third platform, much more heavily guarded. Engaging it would be highly dangerous.
M10_040_030_KS: We need that silicon.  With the right Strike Groups, we can take them.
M10_050_010_FI: Radaa forces around the last mining platform have been eliminated.
M10_060_010_FI: Contact! A Radaa Battlecruiser has jumped in. It has enough firepower to cripple our fleet.
M10_060_020_KS: We can use the Mining Platform as a battering ram. Tyrra would like that.
M10_060_030_FI: Multiple Engineer Craft are needed to steer it into the Battlecruiser.
M10_070_010_KS: The Engineer Craft are locked in.
M10_070_020_FI: Mining platform is on course to collide with the Battlecruiser.
M10_080_020_FI: Battlecruiser eliminated. Radaa forces are in retreat.
M10_100_010_FI: Critical ship loss, resources depleted. Fleet in full retreat.
M10_110_010_FI: Radaa forces around this mining platform are in tight formation, which will block any attempt at docking.  Recommend securing the other platforms.
M10_Description: Capture a precious resource needed to fight the Radaa.
M10_Objective_01: Dock 3 Engineer Craft to the Mining Platform.
M10_Objective_03: Dock 3 Engineer Craft to the Mining Platform.
M10_Objective_05: Destroy enemy patrol protecting the final Mining Platform.
M10_Objective_07: Defend Mining Platform while Engineer Craft salvage Resonant Silicon.
M11_010_010_A_FI: Our resource teams have extracted the resonant silicon from the mining platforms.
M11_010_020_A_HA: Silicon yield from the platforms is higher than I expected, even without the third platform.  My team is commencing analysis.
M11_010_030_A_KS: I've had a moment to review the Bentusi data, silicon alone will not be enough to counter their weapon.  What's your plan, Hauk?
M11_010_040_A_HA: We have a lot to work with, but without a Radaan weapons engineer to consult, we will need more time.
M11_010_050_A_KS: Time is the one thing we don't have. Intel, find us a consultant...fast.
M11_010_060_A_FI: Accessing recon reports... cross referencing personnel codes from when the Radaa were consulting with Hiigaran Command... found it.  Radaa weapons architects identified on a Destroyer in the Hiigara System, Quadrant Omega.
M11_010_070_A_FI: Exact position and ship ID is unclear.
M11_010_080_A_KS: Won't be my first hunt for a dune snake, Intel.  Let's get close.
M11_010_100_A_KS: Received.  Prepare for hyperspace on my mark.  Mark!
M11_020_010_KS: Hyperspace jump successful. Confirm location of the ship holding the weapons architects.
M11_020_020_FI: Unfortunately Commander, not possible. We were led to believe there was a single Radaa Destroyer, but we have detected three in this sector.
M11_020_030_FI: Recommend investigating each coordinate to scan for our target.
M11_030_010_FI: Scan reads negative. Targets not on board this ship. Proceed to next coordinate.
M11_040_010_FI: Negative. Weapon architect designation not detected on this Destroyer. Continue the search.
M11_050_010_FI: Personnel scan confirms - the architects are passengers on this Destroyer.
M11_050_020_FI: Priority alert! The Destroyer has detected our presence and is fleeing to the nearest hyperspace gate.
M11_050_030_KS: All ships! Destroy that gate before the Radaa use it to escape.
M11_060_010_FI: Enemy units entering the system to defend the Destroyers.
M11_070_020_KS: We've taken away their escape route.  Capture the Destroyer, and secure the personnel we came for.
M11_070_030_FI: Engineer Craft are needed to latch on to the Destroyer and haul it back to the Mothership.
M11_080_010_FI: Destroyer under tow. Warning, additional Radaa craft detected.
M11_080_020_KS: They may want to eliminate the Destroyer before we complete the transfer. All ships, move to defend.
M11_090_010_FI: Heavy Radaa forces are jumping in and are now targeting the Mothership.
M11_090_020_KS: We'll have to eliminate the Radaa to get the weapons architects onto the Mothership.
M11_100_010_FI: Destroyer is in range of the Mothership.  Radaa threats are eliminated.
M11_100_020_KS: Architects secured. Hyperspace jump on my mark.
M11_150_010_FI: Resources depleted. Ships destroyed. The Destroyer has evaded capture.
M11_160_010_FI: Regroup! Targeted Destroyer has escaped through the Hyperspace Gate. Repeat: The Destroyer has escaped.
M11_170_010_FI: Destroyer with the Weapon Architects has been destroyed.  Our target is lost.
M11_Description: Locate and capture the Radaa weapon architects.
M11_Objective_01: Locate the ship containing the weapon architects.
M11_Objective_03: Defend the Mothership until the Personnel Craft arrives.
M11_Objective_03a: Dock 3 Engineer Craft to the Radaa Destroyer.
M11_Objective_03b: Escort the Personnel Craft back to the Mothership.
M13_010_005_A_KS: All Radaa Shipyards eliminated. We've crippled their construction capacity.
M13_010_010_A_KS: Mothership fully operational. Fleet intact. Engineering, was that enough time?
M13_010_020_A_HA: We have analyzed the plans and distributed the silicon across all our ships.
M13_010_030_A_KS: Is it enough to protect the fleet?
M13_010_040_A_HA: I've run hundreds of simulations. It has to work. It WILL work.
M13_010_060_A_FI: Shatter Station and Radaa Tower are still in orbit around Hiigara.  Amma has been broadcasting an ultimatum to the planet.
M13_010_070_A_AR: Hiigaran Command, according to interstellar law, you are allowed a narrow window to make good on the binding agreement you inherited. That period has ended. I don't want to unleash Shatter Station on the surface of your homeworld... but I will if I must and make no mistake, I will use your own people to rebuild.
M13_010_090_A_HA: This is NOT going to go like you planned, Amma.
M13_010_100_A_KS: Prepare the jump to Hiigara.  On.  My.  Mark.
M13_020_010_KS: The Radaa have been waiting for us.
M13_020_020_HA: My team have prepared our defences.
M13_020_040_AR: Hiigaran Mothership. The Radaa are prepared to accept your surrender.
M13_020_050_KS: Coms on lockdown. Do not respond.
M13_020_060_AR: Hiigaran Command, you ARE our property. Stand down your fleet.
M13_020_070_GR: Do not test us further!  If you continue to resist I will relish tearing the Progenitor Core from your smoking hull.
M13_020_080_AR: Very well. We have exhausted our efforts to enforce the law peacefully. Commander Giitan, proceed.
M13_020_090_GR: Of course, mother. Command confirmed. Engaging Shatter Station.
M13_020_110_FI: No damage reported. Our Fleet remains intact.
M13_020_120_KS: Mothership is fully functional. Chief Engineer Hauk, you and your team were successful. Congratulations!
M13_020_130_HA: Let's not celebrate yet, Commander. To destroy Shatter Station we will need to disable *its* Shield Emitters.
M13_020_140_FI: The Radaa Tower has also activated internal shielding.
M13_020_150_KS: They are scrambling. Intel, can you intercept their coms?
M13_020_170_GR: They must have counter-terminated the Shatter attack, we must re-calibrate!  How long until full recalibration?  How long--
M13_020_180_HA: Command, that could work. We won't be able to change our settings to match. Unless we withdraw...
M13_020_190_KS: No. This will end now. How long will it take them to re-calibrate the Shatter pulse?
M13_020_200_HU: Unknown - we have some time, but no way to know exactly.
M13_020_210_KS: Then we had best strike quickly.
M13_040_010_FI: Docking complete. Engineer Craft will remain vulnerable until it disables the Emitter.
M13_050_010_FI: Emitter disabled. Wings on the Shatter Station now exposed.
M13_050_020_KS: Concentrate fleet firepower on those wings.
M13_060_010_FI: More Shield Emitters still active.  Track them down and disable them.
M13_070_010_FI: Shields still active. Additional Shield Emitters must be disabled.
M13_080_010_FI: One more Shield Emitter must be disabled.
M13_090_010_FI: More wings of Shatter Station vulnerable to attack.
M13_100_010_FI: Additional Shatter Station wings now exposed.
M13_110_010_FI: The final set of Shatter Station's wings can now be destroyed.
M13_120_010_KS: Hauk, status update. How long until they re-calibrate Shatter Station?
M13_120_020_HA: Unknown, every sim we run comes back with a different answer.
M13_120_030_KS: Understood, I will do what I can to slow them down.
M13_130_020_HA: If Shatter Station fires again, we have minimal defenses.
M13_130_030_KS: It'll be too late.  We will destroy those wings before they can fire again.
M13_140_010_AR: Hiigaran Command, last chance to surrender. You will not be able to counteract Shatter Station a second time. You will lose everything.
M13_140_020_KS: Amma should be thinking about what she will lose.
M13_140_040_KS: Perhaps, but we can't leave that thing to wreak havoc our planet.  Have the fleet concentrate fire on the Shatter Station wings.
M13_150_010_FI: Damage to final set of wings cascading to Shatter Station Command Module.
M13_150_020_HA: That did it. Shatter Station can't possibly fire again.
M13_150_040_FI: Critical failure of Shatter Station is chaining to their Tower. Destruction imminent.
M13_150_050_KS: Now we stand down.  Victory in your name, Tyrra.
M13_200_010_FI: Too many ships lost - resource reserves spent - Hiigara is lost!
M13_210_010_FI: Readings from Shatter Station indicate it is powering up.
M13_210_020_HA: We didn't make it in time.
M13_220_010_FI: We cannot overcome the internal Radaa Tower shields. Recommend centering attacks on the immediate threat, Shatter Station.
M13_Description: Defend Hiigara while attempting to stop Shatter Station.
M13_Objective_02: Dock an Engineer Craft to a shield emitter.
M13_Objective_04counter: Destroy the wings of the Shatter Station.
M13_Objective_timer: Time until Shatter Station fires again:
M14_010_010_A_HA: Karan S'jet, the first Unbound, gave up her well-earned peace to defend our Homeworld. The Hiigaran people owe a great debt of gratitude to Karan S'jet and my mother, Tyrra Soban, who laid down her life for Hiigara.
M14_010_020_A_HA: While we neutralized the Shatter Station, the mothership was damaged in the battle. It would have to be rebuilt and its technology evolved before we could use it again.
M14_010_030_A_HA: My mother did not live to see the victory that she made possible. Karan S’Jet always spoke about how much she valued her time with Tyrra Soban.
M14_010_040_A_HA: Karan and Hiigaran Command also learned more about what was required to be Navigator and Commander of a Mothership.  Being one with the Core was not just an honor, it was a sacrifice. One that Karan S'jet chose to make until the end of her days.
MT01_Objective_01: Destroy Target Ships while avoiding Gun Platform.
MT01_Objective_02: Complete each exercise of the training regimen.
T01_010_020_KS: It's ok, Fleet Command... Being fused with the Mothership takes getting used to.  Remember your training...flow with the ship, don't grasp at the data.
T01_010_030_TS: You're coming in clear, Karan.  But I can hear everything at the same time...it's amazing!
T01_010_040_KS: Fleet Intelligence will take you through some exercises now Commander.  But I'm here and you can call on me as well.
T01_020_010_FI: Fleet Intelligence Officer on-line. My task is to collate information, analyze sensor data and provide objectives.
T01_020_020_FI: First I will guide you through systems tests.  Open the Sensors Manager now.
T01_020_030_FI: The Sensors Manager shows you a map of your local environment, including the heart of command operations, the Mothership.
T01_020_040_FI: Current mission objectives are also displayed prominently in your sensors manager.
T01_020_060_KS: Commander, let go.  Right now, self is your enemy.
T01_030_010_FI: Our next test is of your navigation systems, to help you gain tactical awareness around the Mothership.  First we will try moving around your environment.
T01_030_013_FI: You can also zoom your view in and out.
T01_030_017_FI: You can move your view of the world using several methods.
T01_030_020_FI: You can teleport your viewpoint and instantly move it anywhere within range.
T01_030_040_TS: This is stunning! I have spent years staring into tactical screens but never like this.
T01_030_050_KS: Remember when you merge with the sensor data you can see everything, everywhere.  You can make so many decisions, so quickly.  But you are not infinite, never forget that.
T01_040_010_FI: We will now focus on your fleet of ships and how to command them.  Start by surveying the ships you have available. They are placed into functional formations called Strike Groups.
T01_040_020_FI: You can give Strike Groups movement orders.
T01_040_030_FI: You also have the ability to give commands to more than one Strike Group at a time.
T01_040_035_FI: You can also give Strike Groups attack orders.
T01_040_050_FI: You are now facing simulated enemies, which will not fight back. Of course real enemies will.
T01_040_060_KS: That's it, Commander. You're getting it.
T01_040_080_KS: You are experiencing all the things only I have known. You and I now make a very exclusive pair.
T01_050_010_FI: Tactical Pause allows you to stop the action so that you can plan your next moves, including spending Resources to build new ships.
T01_050_020_FI: You can also retire ships in your Strike Groups that you no longer need, and get some Resources returned to your reserves.
T01_050_040_KS: The ships are all yours now. Be careful with them, like they are a part of you.
T01_050_050_TS: I have always felt that way.
T01_050_060_KS: Not like this. You will hear every loss now.  Be prepared for that.
T01_060_010_FI: You can also set up more advanced movement patterns for your Strike Groups, using waypoints.
T01_060_020_FI: Use waypoints to navigate to attack those enemy ships while avoiding the gun platform.
T01_060_030_FI: This concludes our test of core systems.
T01_070_010_KS: Well done, Commander. But now it's time to push your limits. I am sending you the coordinates for the Radaa meeting point. For this you are on your own. Hyperspace manipulation is for a singular mind.
T01_070_030_TS: It feels just like the simulation but I will not lie, Hyperspatial math is not my strongest suit.
T01_070_040_KS: Just keep control of the equations as you feed them to the Hyperspace Core and then... open the door.
T01_070_050_TS: Roger that... Hyperspace engage on my mark.
